notes: SHIP v1.14.353 - SHIP B (core): FLAT dies, 3D IS the rack-detail view, one OPEN AISLE door. Executes design/SHIP-B-BUILD-PLAN.md edits 1-8; edit 9 (the B4.3 reflow) is CONSCIOUSLY HELD as a separate micro-ship (reasoning below). Owner rulings: design/OWNER-RULINGS.md (F1 confirmed, F2 approved). WHAT CHANGED, all body.rd/redesign-gated (?legacy=1 byte-identical - the reh3d block is _rehRd-gated and the legacy else-branch at the old :35421 is untouched): (1) The FLAT|3D|AISLE segmented mode pill is retired. Per F1, the .reh-3d-toggle CONTAINER STAYS - it is the runtime injection anchor that rackElevation_render3D uses for the CABLES filter chip (appendChild) and the VIEW RAIL + EXPLODE sibling row; deleting it would silently strip the 3D view of its own camera/explode/cable controls. The container is reseeded with a single OPEN AISLE door (new .reh-aisle-door class - filled cyan ring + arrow, styled as a door to another surface, not a segment) wired to forge3d_open(). (2) 3D is now the unconditional rack-detail view: reh3d_restore() (called in the existing double-rAF after rackFlat_applyFit) now calls the new reh3d_activate3D() unconditionally instead of gating on a session pref. reh3d_setMode(mode) is RETIRED and replaced by reh3d_activate3D() (no button toggling, no pref writes, no haptic - it runs automatically on open, and haptic is user-tap feedback). (3) F2 DEVIATION FROM SPEC B4.1 (owner-approved): FLAT is NOT deleted. #rehFlatWrap (the flat elevation) remains in the DOM as the involuntary no-WebGL fallback - reh3d_activate3D leaves .is-3d off when WebGL is unavailable (console.warn, no toast churn - the rack still renders flat, so it is a graceful fallback not a silent failure), and reh3d_fail (three.js load failure) drops .is-3d so the flat elevation reappears (that IS a failure of an attempted load, so it keeps its toast). Deleting flat would have bricked rack detail to a black box on any no-WebGL device - a No-Silent-Failures violation. (4) The per-session mode pref is retired entirely: REH3D_PREF_KEY, reh3d_prefOn, reh3d_prefSet all removed (no external readers - verified by grep). (5) forge3d_close() previously reset to FLAT via reh3d_setMode('flat'); it now calls reh3d_activate3D() to return to the 3D view (the only defined state now), no-op if no #reh3dCanvasHost exists. (6) B4.4 dedup: the standalone 'PHASE RUNNING LONG' anomaly card in deploy_showRackDetail (was ~:35606) is REMOVED; the SAME overrun fact renders in the NERVE card's NEXT ACTION chip (nerve_buildRackCard, always emitted at :35476 on this same screen), so one fact now lives on one surface. deploy_checkPhaseAnomaly still feeds that chip - only the duplicate card is gone. FINDING THAT REDUCED BLAST RADIUS: the CSS reveal (.is-3d shows the mount, its absence shows #rehFlatWrap) already does exactly what F2 needs, so the CSS gate at :10550-10551 was NOT inverted - the inversion is purely in JS (set .is-3d at mount instead of on tap). This also sidesteps the display:contents trap entirely: the DOM structure is untouched, #reh3dMount remains a real box sibling of #rehFlatWrap, never under it. WHY EDIT 9 (B4.3 reflow) IS HELD, NOT DROPPED: recon proved the plan's page model was incomplete - the NEXT ACTION card is rendered by nerve_buildRackCard (a separate function at :49212), not inline in deploy_showRackDetail as assumed. 'Open on NEXT ACTION' is therefore a multi-block layout judgement (does NERVE go just above the 3D block, or above COMPONENTS/phase-dots too?) on a surface only the owner sees. It is pure html-ordering, 100% separable from this WebGL inversion; combining them would make this HIGH-risk ship's device verify unbisectable (the spec's own 'do not combine' principle). Held for a one-line owner placement call + its own micro-ship. RACK SCENE LOCK: UNTOUCHED - no lights, exposure, fog, tone-mapping, type-colour, or geometry value changed. This ship changes the mount reveal path, the control-strip contents, and one duplicate card only; scene internals are LOCKED and were not read into. Gates: inline-JS vm.Script x3 PASS, CSS brace net-0, three-stamp .352->.353, CRLF preserved, ?legacy=1 unaffected. Grep gates: zero reh3d_setMode refs remain, zero REH3D_PREF_KEY, forge3d_open reachable from OPEN AISLE. HIGH-risk (LR-2): own batch slot. DEVICE-VERIFY (clear SW first), BOTH shells (390 + 1024+): open a rack in a deployment - it should open straight into the 3D elevation (not flat, no FLAT|3D|AISLE pill); a single OPEN AISLE door sits above the rack; tapping it opens the FORGE aisle; the CABLES chip + FRONT/ISO/TOP/REAR + EXPLODE controls still appear in/under the strip in 3D; tapping a device in 3D still opens its sheet; closing the aisle returns to the 3D rack (not flat); the overrun warning appears once (in NEXT ACTION), not twice. On a no-WebGL device/context the rack shows the flat elevation instead of a black box. ROLLBACK: revert this commit.
